title: Marketplace Pricing Scientist (6 months contract)
description:
About the role
Our dynamic pricing is rule-based today - conditional logic on surface signals like weather and supply-demand ratios. It works, but it's rigid, and we think it's leaving money on the table.
Our platform team is strong on data engineering and business analysis. What we don't have in-house is the applied economics or algorithmic depth to work out which pricing models are actually right for us. Other platforms have solved versions of this already. We want someone who can tell us which approach fits, prove it on our data, and hand it to our engineers to build.
6-month contract, fully remote and open to candidates anywhere , reporting to the Director, Platform.
What you will deliver

• A read on our existing pricing logic, with a number on the revenue and matching efficiency we're currently giving up

• A shortlist of approaches - mechanism design (VCG-style allocation), algorithmic search (optimal tree search, MCTS), predictive and ML pricing models - weighed against our data maturity, latency limits and commercial goals

• A recommended model, tested offline on GoGoX order and supply data, with the assumptions and failure modes spelled out

• An experiment design for live testing, including guardrails against cannibalising users or driver-partners, and the metrics that call it a win

• A handover pack our data engineers can build from, plus an honest view of what we'd need to hire or train for to own this long term

Who you are

• 5+ years applying economic or optimisation modelling to pricing, matching or incentives in a live two-sided marketplace - ride-hailing, logistics, delivery, travel or e-commerce

• Comfortable across mechanism design, causal inference (diff-in-diff, regression discontinuity, synthetic control), demand elasticity and structural modelling, and modern ML approaches to pricing

• Strong in Python and SQL, and happy working in production data next to engineers rather than handing over a paper

• Master's or PhD in Economics, Operations Research, Statistics or similar - or the industry track record that stands in for it

• Pragmatic about constraints. You recommend what works with the data and engineering we have, not what's most elegant

• Can explain the economics to a commercial audience. We can't act on a recommendation we can't interrogate

• Fluent spoken Cantonese

Cloud Network Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Cloud Networking Engineer to design, deploy, and operate cloud networking infrastructure across one or more major cloud providers. The role covers VPC/VNet design, hybrid connectivity, transit topologies, edge networking, DNS, and the security controls that make cloud networking reliable and safe at scale. The ideal candidate combines deep traditional networking knowledge with cloud-native networking patterns, has built production cloud networks at meaningful scale, and brings strong automation discipline to networking work. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and operate cloud networking architectures including VPC/VNet, subnets, routing, and security groups.

• Build transit hub topologies using AWS Transit Gateway, Azure Virtual WAN, or GCP Network Connectivity Center.

• Design and implement hybrid connectivity using Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect, and VPN.

• Architect edge networking including CDN, global load balancing, and WAF integration.

• Implement DNS strategies including Route 53, Azure DNS, or Cloud DNS with hybrid resolution.

• Design private connectivity to managed services using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, or Private Service Connect.

• Automate cloud networking with Terraform, providing infrastructure-as-code coverage across the network estate.

• Implement network security controls including firewalls, NACLs, security groups, and DDoS protection.

• Operate Kubernetes networking including CNI selection, ingress strategies, and service exposure patterns.

• Build observability for cloud networking including flow logs, traffic insights, and packet capture.

• Drive cost optimization including data transfer reduction and right-sizing of network resources.

• Partner with security teams to harden the network perimeter and enforce zero-trust principles.

• Troubleshoot complex cloud networking issues across cloud and hybrid environments.

• Stay current with cloud networking platform updates and emerging patterns.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, or a related field.

• Ten or more years of experience in networking, with significant time on cloud networking.

• Deep hands-on experience with networking on at least one major cloud provider.

• Strong understanding of routing, switching, BGP, and modern networking fundamentals.

• Hands-on experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, or equivalents).

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code for cloud networking, especially Terraform.

• Strong understanding of cloud security and network controls.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes networking and service mesh fundamentals.

• Strong troubleshooting and packet-level analysis skills.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. - Keep many ongoing projects moving in parallel, setting clear priorities and making sure nothing important falls through the cracks.

- Stay close to the code: write, review, and fix code when needed, and dig into real production workloads alongside the team.

- Proven record managing a team of 5+ engineers that delivered complex backend or infrastructure systems in a fast-paced environment.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform team in our Amsterdam office.

We are a leading proprietary trading firm with an entrepreneurial culture. We value sharp, creative engineers and give them the room and the responsibility to make full use of their abilities.

Your mission is to build and run the platform at the centre of the firm: the source of truth for our proprietary research data, the foundation every department builds on, and the context layer our AI agents depend on. You will make it the place where anyone, human or agent, can find trusted data, understand it, and build on it quickly and safely. Working closely with our Quants and research engineers, you will help shape how the firm does systematic trading.

What you will do

• Own performance at scale. Take ownership of the distributed systems, storage and processing platforms that power our data-intensive applications. You will push them to perform under real market load, from tuning a slow pipeline to designing monitoring and alerting that catches problems before our traders do.

• Build and maintain platform capabilities. Design and maintain the products our users rely on every day: self-provisioned compute, scheduling, transformations, ad-hoc exploration. Treat quants, analysts and other teams as customers of a platform product.

• Make the hard design calls. Be part of the group that shapes the data landscape at Flow Traders. Decide on data modelling, storage formats and processing patterns, weighing performance, cost and maintainability.

• Run what you build. Keep it reliable on busy days, continuously improve resource usage and cost; investigate and resolve data issues and pipeline failures; build operational tooling and runbooks.

• Enable governance and context for AI. Build and maintain the tools that make good governance possible across the firm, such as our data catalog, lineage, access control and configurable data quality rules, and promote their adoption.

• Co-develop with AI, responsibly. Use coding agents daily to design, write, test and review code, while owning the correctness of everything that ships.

• Raise the bar around you. Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions and pairing, including how to work effectively and critically with AI tools.

What you need to succeed

Required

• 8+ years building and operating multiple data platforms in production, across different domains. You have made mistakes along the way and can explain what you would do differently.

• You reason from fundamentals (storage layouts, query execution, networking, distributed systems behavior) when designing systems.

• You are comfortable making trade-offs between latency, cost, consistency and simplicity, and can defend them to engineers and business users alike.

• Strong data modelling and data warehousing experience, including analytical engines (e.g. BigQuery, ClickHouse).

• Extensive hands-on experience with distributed storage, messaging (e.g. Kafka, Pub/Sub), batch and stream processing (e.g. Apache Beam, Spark) and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes).

• Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, with high standards for testing and code quality.

• Solid cloud experience across storage, databases (e.g. AlloyDB) and data processing, preferably GCP and AWS.

• Practical experience with data governance: ownership, lineage, access control, metadata management and data quality frameworks.

• Understanding of how AI systems consume data (retrieval, semantic layers, tool and agent interfaces) and what it takes to make data reliable context for them.

• You enjoy working with demanding internal users, translating vague needs into clear platform capabilities.

• You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical teams, and you like helping others grow.

• Interest in financial markets is a plus; prior trading experience is not required.

At Ovation Healthcare (formerly QHR Health), we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. title: Financial Operations Generalist
description:
About Wonderly

Wonderly is a closed-loop, end-to-end system that self-improves on our customers’ revenue. We serve the home service industry ($1.3T), and can consistently double a new customer’s revenue within 90 days. We make all of our AI and software completely free - and only get paid when our customers make real money. We’re here helping real small businesses make a life, pay for their children’s college tuition, and live the American dream.

Pre-AI SaaS sold tools. AI companies claim they sell outcomes - task done, call answered, lead booked, ticket resolved - but calls or leads aren’t the outcomes that ultimately matter. Revenue is what ultimately matters, and today, none of the AI companies actually promise revenue. Wonderly changes that.

Our 70-person team (mostly in PDE) spent over a year building in stealth; our thesis is that - if you actually want to control the end result (revenue) of a business and deploy AI fast/cheaply, you can’t just build the sexy part (agents), you must also build the unsexy parts and own everything end to end: the system of record layer and the application layer. We built from scratch every software a home service business needs - replacing ServiceTitan, Squarespace, Ringcentral, Jobber, Square, Hubspot, and a dozen others applications. And we built every agent necessary - AI marketing, AI receptionist, AI voice, AI sales outreach, AI sales coaching, AI follow-ups, AI 3D design, AI finance, AI quoting, AI collections, and more - all embedded inside our own system with native data access. As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready Agents to our customers in under 24 hours with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.

We are the most outcome driven business model in the business because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents actually work in driving the end result - revenue. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve our customers’ revenue by 5-20%.

Wonderly already has PMF and has gone from 0 → 1 (we are happy to share more over a call), with very clear moat and deep industry knowledge that took a team of 70 hardcore A-players 18 months to build (we are at least 2 years ahead of anyone else in the space). We believe Wonderly has the potential to be a $100B - $1T outcome. The market is massive: home service businesses across North America (a $1.3T market). We’ve raised over $50M from top-tier investors, have $20M a year in free cashflow from another product line (Motion), and all that money gets pumped into Wonderly .
About the Hiring Managers
Hi, we’re Chander and Harry, Wonderly ’s CTO and CEO.
You’ll report directly to one of us. We’re looking for someone we can trust to own the operational details that keep Wonderly running-from getting the numbers right to working through a vendor contract or fixing a broken process.
You don’t need to have seen every problem before. You do need to ask good questions, exercise sound judgment, and follow through. As you build context and earn trust, you’ll take on more ownership across the business.
The Role
We’re hiring someone to own the financial and business operations behind Wonderly .
Accounting is roughly a third of the role. You’ll make sure vendors get paid correctly, coordinate month-end close with our external accountants, and keep tax requirements and financial systems organized. The rest spans contracts, procurement, insurance, equity administration, and the operational problems that come with a growing company.
We want someone with an accounting foundation who wants broad business ownership. You should be comfortable investigating an unfamiliar charge, working through a vendor renewal, coordinating with outside counsel, and building a process so the same issue is easier next time.
Your responsibilities will include:

Recognized by Everest Group as a pioneer and leader in the emerging Finance Risk Intelligence (FRI) category, Oversight is helping define the future of AI-powered financial risk management.

Position Overview: Job Purpose

Oversight is seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Engineer to join the Onboarding organization. This engineer will support customer implementations, troubleshoot complex production issues, analyze cloud data pipelines, and help operationalize new platform capabilities. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, works independently, embraces AI-assisted engineering, and can balance multiple customer implementations while delivering high-quality solutions.

• Analyze, debug, and optimize SQL queries and data processing workflows.

Qualifications

title: Adjuster-TFS
description:
By joining Sedgwick , you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Adjuster-TFS PRIMARY PURPOSE : To handle losses and claims for property and casualty insurers.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

• Examines insurance policies and other records to determine insurance coverage.

• Interviews, telephones, and/or corresponds with claimant and witnesses regarding claim.

• Consults police and hospital records and inspects property damage to determine extent of company's liability and varying methods of investigation according to type of insurance.

• Estimates cost of repair, replacement, or compensation.

• Prepares report of findings and negotiates settlement with claimant.

• Recommends litigation by legal department when settlement cannot be negotiated.

• Attends litigation hearings.

• Revises case reserves in assigned claims files to cover probable costs.

• Assists in preparing loss experience report to help determine profitability and calculates adequate future rates.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

• Performs other duties as assigned.

• Supports the organization's quality program(s).

• Travels as required.

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

What’s unique about this role?

The Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer demonstrates deep technical expertise and leadership in cloud infrastructure, automation, application hosting, and AI-enabled engineering practices. This role designs robust, scalable cloud solutions that align with business and security requirements; mentors engineers; and applies AI responsibly to improve delivery, operations, and reliability.

What will this person do?

• Lead the design and implementation of complex Azure infrastructure solutions, ensuring scalability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.

• Champion Infrastructure as Code and automation across all environments, establishing best practices and standards.

• Architect, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters for high availability, security, and performance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support microservices architectures and application modernization.

• Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, operational tooling, and observability practices.

• Mentor associate and regular engineers on cloud tools, AI-enabled workflows, troubleshooting, and responsible engineering practices

• Participate in agile leadership activities, including story grooming and technical reviews.

• Advanced expertise with Azure infrastructure, security, networking, and automation.

• Expertise in Infrastructure as Code, including Terraform, ARM, and Bicep, and CI/CD workflows.

• In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes administration, scaling, and monitoring.

• Strong background supporting large-scale, distributed application hosting.

• Proficiency in scripting and automation in multiple languages.

• Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve infrastructure-as-code quality, documentation, operational analysis, and developer workflows.

• Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data handling, security, privacy, model limitations, human-in-the-loop review, and auditability.

• Experience integrating or operating cloud AI services and API-based automation while applying least-privilege access, secret management, monitoring, and cost controls.

• Ability to assess AI-generated technical output, validate it through testing and peer review, and prevent unsafe or unverified changes from reaching production.

• Experience applying observability data, automation, and AI-assisted analysis to incident detection, response, and post-incident improvement.

• Experience working within agile teams and influencing DevOps culture.

• Excellent leadership, communication, and mentoring skills.
